Solicited quotes, negotiated and procured material from commercial vendors. Extensive Knowledge of the Naval Aviation Logistics Command Management Information System (NALCOMIS), MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Relational Supply, Base Level Item Tracking System, Electronic Retrograde Management System(ERP),  and Fund Administration and Standardized Document Automatic System(FASTDATA).
